items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: In fact, I learned in later years that Manuel Mineta came up under him.

ctx.x: Did he play with any band or something like that?
Yeah, he played in band. In fact, I learned in later years that Manuel Mineta came up under him.
Mm-hmm. And when did he die? Did you know him?
